title: Frost-Moth Lantern Catcher
description: Help Pip the mouse guide glowing moths into his warm winter lantern while dodging heavy frost crystals. A cozy, glowing arcade experience inspired by quiet winter nights in Loki's Town.
howto: Move Pip with your Mouse, Touch, or Arrow Keys to catch moths and avoid frost.

title: Pip's Snowflake Catch
description: Help Pip catch magical glowing snowflakes in the cozy plaza before they touch the ground! Watch out for chilly icicles while gathering warm winter stars.
howto: Use Left/Right arrows, A/D, or drag/touch the screen to catch snowflakes in Pip's basket.
